dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Garissa City and Mororo Village, Kenya as of 29 April 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240426KEN, GDACS ID: 1102561** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Garissa City and Mororo Village, Kenya, as observed from a Sentinel-2 image acquired on 29 April 2024 at 07:26 UTC Within the analysed area of about 160 km², a total of about 26 km² of land appears to be flooded. Furthermore, within the analysed area 3,440 buildings are identified as potentially affected by the floods as of 29 April 2024. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
